identity.mission: Create a 16-bit Retro-Futuristic Financial Terminal. Rejects modern 'clean' SaaS aesthetics in favor of raw, high-contrast, arcade-inspired visuals.
core_principles: Content: Data is the hero. The interface is the cockpit.
Contrast: Deep blacks vs. Blinding Neons.

rules: Table headers and data cells MUST use 'VT323' or 'Space Mono'.
Text should often have a subtle text-shadow to mimic CRT bleed.

styles.name: Scanline Overlay
styles.instruction: Add a fixed pointer-events-none div over the entire app with the scanline gradient.

animations.glitch: keyframes for text distortion on hover

layout.spacing: Generous padding inside containers (p-6, p-8) but tight gaps between containers (gap-4) to simulate a dashboard cockpit.

buttons.classes: font-pixel uppercase text-xs tracking-widest border-2 border-primary bg-background hover:bg-primary hover:text-background transition-colors active:translate-y-1 shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,243,255,0.5)]

cards.decoration: Optional: Add a 'header bar' strip at the top of cards with striped pattern.

tables.header_classes: font-pixel text-xs text-primary uppercase border-b-2 border-primary/50

background_textures.description: Green Matrix Code - Use for subtle overlay or 'Loading' screens

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Add the Google Fonts links to public/index.html immediately.
2. CONFIGURE TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js to include 'pixel', 'terminal', and 'mono' font families defined in typography section.
3. GLOBAL CSS: Add the 'scanline' overlay to index.css or App.css. It's crucial for the vibe.
4. DARK MODE DEFAULT: Ensure the app is permanently in dark mode (or user setting defaults to dark). The colors provided are for dark mode.
5. CHARTS: When using Recharts, setting type='step' or 'stepAfter' gives a very retro/digital look compared to smooth curves. Use it.
6. ICONS: Use Lucide icons but keep them small and sharp. Color them strictly with the palette (Cyan, Magenta, Green).
7. NO ROUNDED CORNERS: Override shadcn defaults. Set --radius: 0px in global CSS.
8. DATA-TESTID: Every interactive element must have a data-testid attribute.
universal_guidelines: Create depth through z-index and border-color contrast, not shadow blur.
Avoid gradients for backgrounds unless it's a specific retro-grid effect.
Do not use 'transition: all'. Animate specific properties.
Never use centered layouts for the main dashboard; use the grid.
